theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_dilation_pushforward
theorems.statement: ∀ P : ℕ, ∃ dil : ∀ k : ℕ, ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, ∀ (k : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam (X - Y) = dil k lam X - dil k lam Y) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, dil k lam⁻¹ (dil k lam X) = X) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).mass = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ k) * X.mass) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, (dil k lam X).support = (fun x => lam • x) '' X.support) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity (dil k lam X)) ∧ ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (k + 1), (dil (k + 1) lam X).boundary = dil k lam X.boundary
